en.title: SPACE
en.desc: Selected professional architecture work focused on the decisions behind form: solar access, public realm, street scale, façade expression, views and environmental performance.
en.question: How can architectural form respond to yield and technical constraints without losing spatial quality, identity and human scale?
en.built: This section brings together 60 Denmark Street, Iglu Arden and 87 Queensbridge / OSK. The emphasis is on massing, solar analysis, public realm, façade systems and tower-form decisions rather than on presenting raw submission pages.
en.judgement: I am most interested in design moves that have visible consequences. A change in orientation, proportion or geometry should improve something tangible — daylight, views, public space, efficiency or the experience of the street.
taste: KEEP
Design moves with measurable spatial consequences: better light, views, public realm or efficiency.
REMOVE
Formal complexity that cannot explain what it improves.
TEST
Bring computational feedback earlier into massing so performance and architectural judgement evolve together.

zh.title: 空间
zh.meta: 建筑 / 空间 / 环境判断
zh.role: 设计 / 参数化分析 / 视觉表达
zh.output: 建筑设计 / 投标 + 竞赛
zh.desc: 在建筑事务所工作的时间里,我参与了大量的建筑项目,涵盖了住宅,商业,城市规划.不同的项目让我了解到了不同策划,分析,设计的模式,尝试用不同方式解决设计中的问题,建立人与机器之间的桥梁.
zh.question: 建筑形式如何在产出与技术约束之间取得平衡，同时保留空间品质、识别性与人的尺度？
zh.built: 这一部分整合 60 Denmark Street规划竞标项目、Iglu Arden 学生公寓项目与 87 Queensbridge / OSK 大型住宅楼竞赛.重点展示体量、日照分析、公共空间、立面系统与高层形体判断.
zh.judgement:
研究与思考如何通过参数与审美一并解决不同的设计问题.
建筑朝向、建筑尺度或几何的变化,通过参数化分析改善日照、视野、公共空间、效率或街道体验.
taste: 保留
能够带来可衡量空间结果的设计动作：更好的日照、视野、公共空间或效率.
移除
无法说明具体价值的形式复杂度.
测试
让计算反馈更早进入体量设计，使性能判断与建筑判断同步演化.

en.title: SYSTEM
en.role: SYSTEM DESIGN / INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE / UX / DEVELOPMENT
en.tools: HTML / CSS / JS / MAPBOX / RHINO / GRASSHOPPER
en.desc: Systems for turning complex studio knowledge and urban information into interfaces that are easier to browse, understand and use.
en.question: How can complex information become useful without forcing the user to understand the internal structure behind it?
en.built: This section combines Studio Library with City as Data / Melbourne City Model work. One reorganises recurring design knowledge around user intent; the other translates spatial geometry and urban data into a browser-based city interface.
en.judgement: The recurring decision is what not to show. I prioritise clear entry points, spatial orientation and progressive disclosure over exposing every tool, folder or dataset at once.
media: CITY AS DATA / MELBOURNE CITY MODEL
RHINO → MAPBOX → WEB / SPATIAL DATA WORKFLOW
taste: KEEP
Clear, high-confidence entry points that match what the user is trying to do.
REMOVE
Internal folder logic, tool directories and duplicated information that increase cognitive load.
TEST
How search, spatial browsing and progressive disclosure can shorten the path from question to useful resource.

zh.title: 系统
zh.meta: 信息架构 / 城市数据 / 界面
zh.role: 系统设计 / 信息架构 / UX / 开发
zh.tools: HTML / CSS / JS / MAPBOX / RHINO / GRASSHOPPER
zh.output: 知识系统 / 交互式城市工具
zh.desc: 把复杂的事务所知识与城市信息转化成更容易浏览、理解和使用的界面系统.
zh.question: 如何让复杂信息变得真正可用，而不是要求用户先理解背后的内部组织结构？
zh.built: 这一部分把 Studio Library 与 City as Data / Melbourne City Model 放在同一个系统设计章节中.前者围绕用户意图重新组织设计知识，后者把空间几何与城市数据转化为浏览器中的城市界面.
zh.judgement: 反复出现的核心判断，是“哪些东西不应该出现”.我优先保留明确入口、空间定位感与渐进式信息展开，而不是一次性暴露所有工具、文件夹和数据.
media: 城市即数据 / 墨尔本城市模型
RHINO → MAPBOX → WEB / 空间数据工作流
工具导向 → 任务导向的信息架构
taste: 保留
对应用户真实意图、无需解释的高置信度入口.
移除
增加认知负担的内部文件夹逻辑、工具目录与重复信息.
测试
搜索、空间浏览与渐进式展示能否缩短从问题到可用资源的路径.

en.title: CODE
en.tools: RHINO / GRASSHOPPER / PYTHON / HTML / CSS / JS / AI CODING AGENTS
en.output: PARAMETRIC WORKFLOWS / INTERNAL TOOLS / INTERACTIVE PROTOTYPES
en.desc: Computational work that turns repeated design problems into tools, systems and interactive prototypes.
en.question: Where should computation automate a process, and where should judgement remain visible and editable?
en.built: This section brings together Rhino Tabs, Grasshopper and Python workflows, automation, web tooling and AI-assisted prototyping. The common thread is not a specific software package, but designing the logic between input, transformation and decision.
en.judgement: The tool should reduce friction without hiding the decision. I keep computational systems legible enough to critique, change and reuse rather than treating automation as a black box.
media: AI PROTOTYPING / CLAUDE CODE + CODEX + CHATGPT
taste: KEEP
Tools that make the next useful action obvious and keep design intent visible.
REMOVE
Automation that adds complexity without reducing meaningful work.
TEST
How AI-assisted building can stay fast without becoming visually or behaviourally generic.

zh.title: 代码
zh.meta: GRASSHOPPER / PYTHON / 工具 / AI 原型
zh.role: 计算设计 / 工具开发 / 原型
zh.tools: RHINO / GRASSHOPPER / PYTHON / HTML / CSS / JS / AI CODING AGENTS
zh.output: 参数化工作流 / 内部工具 / 交互原型
zh.desc: 把重复出现的设计问题转化为工具、系统与交互原型的计算实践.
zh.question: 什么应该被计算自动化，什么判断又应该继续保持可见、可修改？
zh.built: 这一部分整合 Rhino Tabs、Grasshopper 与 Python 工作流、自动化、网页工具以及 AI 辅助原型.共同点不是某一种软件，而是对输入、转换与判断之间逻辑关系的设计.
zh.judgement: 工具应该减少摩擦，但不能把判断藏起来.我希望计算系统始终足够清晰，可以被批评、修改和复用，而不是成为黑箱.
media: GRASSHOPPER + PYTHON / 参数化工作流
自动化 / RHINO ↔ REVIT / 工作室流程
AI 原型 / CLAUDE CODE + CODEX + CHATGPT
PROMPT → 输出 → 批评 → 迭代
taste: 保留
让下一步操作自然明确，同时保持设计意图可见的工具.
移除
没有减少真正工作量、反而增加复杂度的自动化.
测试
AI 辅助开发如何保持速度，同时避免视觉和行为上的模板化.

en.title: OBSERVATION
en.desc: Photography as an ongoing exercise in attention: people, buildings, incidental gestures and landscape fragments selected and sequenced over time.
en.question: What makes an image worth keeping when nothing dramatic is happening?
en.built: The work is organised as an authored sequence rather than a masonry archive: DENSITY → DISTANCE → OBJECT → LIGHT → TRACE. Selection and sequencing are treated as part of the image-making.
en.judgement: I look for tension between geometry and behaviour, clarity without over-composition, and frames that gain more meaning when they sit beside another frame.
taste: KEEP
Images with one clear visual reason to exist, even when the subject is ordinary.
REMOVE
Technically polished photographs that say the same thing as a stronger frame.
TEST
Whether sequencing by perceptual association creates a reading that no single image can carry.

zh.title: 观察
zh.meta: 摄影 / 序列 / 视觉判断
zh.tools: 中画幅 / 135 胶片 / 数码 / 序列编辑
zh.desc: 把摄影当作一种持续的注意力练习：人物、建筑、偶然动作与风景碎片，被不断筛选并重新排序.
zh.question: 当没有明显戏剧事件发生时，什么样的图像仍然值得被保留？
zh.built: 作品不再以普通 masonry 图库呈现，而是按 DENSITY → DISTANCE → OBJECT → LIGHT → TRACE 的顺序形成一条有作者判断的观看路径.挑选和排序本身也是拍摄的一部分.
zh.judgement: 我在意几何与行为之间的张力、清晰但不过度构图的画面，以及一张图像与另一张并置后产生的新含义.
taste: 保留
即使主题平常，也有明确视觉理由存在的图像.
去除
技术上精致，但表达重复于更强画面的照片.
测试
按感知关联而非时间顺序编排，能否产生单张图像无法承担的新阅读.

en.title: RESEARCH
en.tools: MACHINE LEARNING / PYTHON / PARAMETRIC PLANNING / DATA VISUALISATION
en.desc: TODAI — a machine-learning-powered planning tool for Transit-Oriented Development, developed during my UNSW Computational Design degree.
en.question: Can machine learning support early-stage planning decisions for Transit-Oriented Development without reducing the process to a single optimisation score?
en.built: The thesis explored how planning data, computational generation and machine learning could be combined into a decision-support workflow for TOD. The portfolio version will present the research as a visual research artifact rather than as a conventional academic paper.
en.judgement: The most useful role for computation is not to replace planning judgement, but to expose alternatives, patterns and trade-offs early enough to influence a design decision.
taste: KEEP
Research outputs that make the relationship between data, model logic and planning decision legible.
REMOVE
Academic complexity that does not help explain the actual decision-support idea.
TEST
How the original research could be reframed today as an AI-native interactive planning interface.

zh.title: 研究
zh.meta: 机器学习 / TOD / 规划工具
zh.role: 研究 / 计算设计 / 可视化
zh.tools: 机器学习 / PYTHON / 参数化规划 / 数据可视化
zh.output: 毕业论文 / 规划工具 / CAADRIA 论文
zh.desc: TODAI —— 一个面向公共交通导向开发（TOD）的机器学习规划工具，完成于 UNSW Computational Design 本科阶段.
zh.question: 机器学习能否辅助 TOD 的早期规划判断，同时避免把复杂的规划过程压缩成单一优化分数？
zh.built: 论文研究了如何把规划数据、计算生成与机器学习组合成 TOD 的决策支持工作流.作品集版本会把它重新编辑成一个视觉化 research artifact，而不是传统论文页面.
zh.judgement: 计算最有价值的角色不是代替规划判断，而是更早暴露备选方案、模式与权衡，让它们真正进入设计决策.
taste: 保留
能够清楚说明数据、模型逻辑与规划判断关系的研究输出.
去除
无法帮助解释决策支持概念的学术复杂度.
测试
如果今天重新做一次，如何把原研究改造成 AI-native 的交互式规划界面.
